name: OpenAI
description: OpenAI API platform for GPT models, embeddings, and AI capabilities

config.setupInstructions:
The OpenAI integration requires an Admin API Key (not a regular API key) to read organization users, projects, and audit data.

Step 1 — Create an Admin API Key
1. Sign in to https://platform.openai.com as an Organization Owner
2. Go to Settings > Organization > Admin keys (https://platform.openai.com/settings/organization/admin-keys)
3. Click Create new key
4. Name it (e.g. "Comp AI") and grant these scopes:
   - api.management.read   (required for user/project listings)
   - api.model.read        (required for model availability checks)
5. Copy the key (starts with "sk-admin-") — it's shown only once

Important: Regular API keys (sk-..., sk-proj-...) cannot list organization users and will return HTTP 401/403 with "Missing scopes" errors.

Step 2 — Paste the Admin key in the integration settings below
